plugin.name: Resident Evil 6 Fusion Fix
hudaspect.description: Auto uses the whole screen width: HUD elements on the left and right sides go to the screen's edges. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps the HUD in a centered box of that aspect.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies normal and vehicle gameplay FOV. Scripted, weapon and unknown camera types keep their framing; cinematic view modes remain unchanged.
cutsceneborders.description: Letterbox keeps the original cinematic bars; Pillarbox keeps cutscenes at 16:9 with bars at the sides on wider screens. Without the letterbox the picture fills the height and keeps its framing. Applies from the next cutscene.
fpslimit.description: The frame rate cap of the game's VARIABLE frame rate option (120 in the original game).
windowmode.description: The window when the game's own Full Screen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game while its window isn't active. Off keeps it running in the background.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the Capcom and engine startup logos and the startup notices that only need OK ("Load successful." and the auto-save notice).
SplitScreenVertical.description: Split local co-op left and right instead of top and bottom. On a 32:9 screen each player gets a 16:9 view. Applies when split screen starts.
SplitScreenSwapTopBottom.description: Swap the two players' views in local split-screen co-op (top and bottom, or left and right). Applies when split screen starts.
DisableDamageOverlay.description: Hide the overlay shown at low health.
DisableDBNOEffects.description: Hide the screen effects while the player is down.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show both players' health on supported Logitech keyboards (Logitech G HUB).
menu.title: Plugins
menu.restarthelp: Applies the next time the game starts
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changes.
menu.presethelp: Choose with Left/Right, then confirm to apply. Vanilla keeps the original logo sequence and cinematic borders. Recommended and Enhanced skip the logos, add side borders to cutscenes and enable RGB lighting. Player preferences and values shared by every preset are kept. Restore defaults resets every setting.
menu.pluginshelp: Settings for this fix and other compatible plugins.
fmv.description: Original aspect shows the movies inside the game's centred 16:9 frame. On screens wider than 16:9, Fill enlarges the two story movies, which have black bars in the file, until their picture fits the screen. No picture is cut off or stretched.
textlanguage.description: Choose the language of the fix’s settings and help. Automatic follows the Windows interface language.
confinecursor.description: Keep the pointer inside the game window while it is active. Release it when unfocused or while the developer overlay is open.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.title: Update available
update.short: An update is available. Open Plugins for details.
skippressstart.description: Continue past the first Press Start prompt once it is ready. Does not confirm save, loading, error or checkpoint messages.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Choose Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo face, shoulder, trigger and Back button icons. Auto uses Xbox. Keyboard and mouse names stay unchanged.
